offering_description.value: Provides artificial lift and production equipment, rentals and field services that help oil and gas producers extract and move well fluids. Sells to upstream operators in US onshore basins and delivers through equipment rental fleets and field crews.

primary_products.value: gas lift systems; plunger lift systems; production chemicals; wellhead and production equipment

primary_services.value: equipment rental; field installation and maintenance; well production optimization

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators

revenue_model.value: product sales: production equipment and chemicals sold to operators; service fees: installation, maintenance and well monitoring services; rental or leasing: artificial lift equipment rented to operators
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: field services for well production, sold to oil and gas operators; OEM / manufacturer: builds some lift and production equipment, sold to operators and used in its own rental fleet

geography_served.value: US national: Permian, Eagle Ford, Haynesville and other US onshore oil and gas basins

specialization.value: related lines: artificial lift equipment, production chemicals and field services for the same producing wells

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sold directly to oil and gas operators; own locations: field service yards and branch locations near producing basins

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and safety rules for oilfield operations, enforced by EPA and state oil and gas regulators

notes: Based on general knowledge; product mix, size category and value chain roles may be imprecise.
